plugins.name: vibe-kanban-indie
plugins.description: Orchestrate vibe-kanban-indie from Claude Code — drive the kanban board and a crew of coding agents via a bundled MCP server. Board-shape aware: nested sub-boards, per-board custom columns discovered from project_statuses (never hardcoded), per-board orchestrator prompts, and sub-issue hierarchy (a card with children is never dispatched). Family-first pipeline routing (OpenCode vs Claude Code, never mixed; Codex reviews both) via the classify-task skill, lane-aware parallel dispatch with a bounded blocking-edge dependency gate and a WIP cap, and the VK-ESCALATE misclassification tripwire. Ships the vibe-kanban, product-manager, classify-task, compose-pipeline, answer-questions, knowledge-recall, knowledge-enrich, and release skills, the single-loop orchestrator (monitor-first two-mode tick), product, planner, decider, intake, and release agents, lifecycle prompts, and looped-orchestrator launchers

plugins.name: sombrax-codex

plugins.name: vibecrew
plugins.description: Orchestrate a VibeCrew board from Claude Code, MCP-free, over its REST API via a bundled stdlib-only Python client. The orchestrator agent is HOST-TICKED — VibeCrew's runtime owns the loop and delivers each tick with a status digest; the agent replies with a CADENCE line and arms no cron of its own (see reference/tick-contract.md). Family-first pipeline routing (OpenCode vs Claude Code, plus Pi as an explicit-ask-only, uncalibrated arm; never mixed; Codex reviews all) via the classify-task skill, lanes (epic + sub-cards + blocking edges) for parallel dispatch, and pipeline overrides with merge-on delivery and post-plan gates. Ships the vibecrew, product-manager, classify-task, and answer-questions skills, the orchestrator (Claude + OpenCode twins) / product / planner / coder / decider agents, the pipeline-stage crew-bundle (vibecrew-product/-planner/-coder/-reviewer subagents + code-review-checklist skill — canonical source the app vendors), lifecycle prompts, and a standalone orchestrator launcher
